_readme: How to get each secret badge. From Ship/research/whatifdisasters-badges-2026-11.json: every how-to has two independent sources (Deadeye and codeshunterx4 videos, both 2026-10-21). Titles marked titleConfirmed appear in both videos; the rest are read off one video.

guides.name: Statue
guides.howTo: Get to a safe hiding spot before the disaster starts, then don't touch any controls until the round ends. If you move, or the disaster pushes your character, it doesn't count.
steps: During the countdown, run to a covered spot where the disaster can't move or kill you (both creators hid inside a building)
When the disaster starts, stop moving completely and stay AFK
Stay alive until the round ends; the achievement pops up in the lobby with the results screen
guides.title: Statue
guides.caveat: Neither guide says whether the lobby AFK toggle counts as standing still.

guides.name: First To Go
guides.howTo: Be the first player in the server to die after the disaster starts. The simplest way is to reset your character right after the disaster begins.
steps: Wait in the map until the countdown ends and the 'WHAT IF...' disaster title appears
Reset your character straight away (or die to the disaster before anyone else does)
The achievement is awarded right away
guides.title: Speedrunner
guides.caveat: One player reports it didn't pop even after dying first, and one of the two creators says some secret badges took a few tries.

guides.name: Crow's Nest
guides.howTo: On Downtown City, climb the yellow construction crane and be standing on it, out on the edge of the jib, when the disaster ends.
steps: Wait until a round lands on Downtown City
Climb the yellow tower crane at the construction site
Go out to the edge of the crane's horizontal arm (jib)
Stay on the crane and survive until the disaster ends
guides.title: Skyfall

guides.name: Lightkeeper
guides.howTo: On Coastal Resort, take the lighthouse lift (yellow 'Ride Up' button inside) and be standing on the very top of the lighthouse, above the lamp, when the disaster ends.
steps: On Coastal Resort, follow Lighthouse Rd up the hill to the red-and-white lighthouse
Go inside and press the yellow 'Ride Up' button to reach the lamp room
Climb onto the very top of the lighthouse, above the light
Survive there until the disaster ends
guides.title: Lightkeeper
guides.caveat: One player says standing on the lighthouse didn't count. You have to be on the very top, above the lamp.

guides.name: Tank Top
guides.howTo: On Suburban Neighborhood, climb the ladder of the blue water tower and be standing on top of the tank's lid when the disaster ends.
steps: On Suburban Neighborhood, head to the tall blue water tower
Climb the ladder up the tower legs
Stand on the pointed roof (lid) of the tank
Survive there until the disaster ends
guides.title: Apex

guides.name: Into The Abyss
guides.howTo: Swim (or take a boat out and dive) all the way down until you touch the seabed, then survive the rest of the disaster anywhere.
steps: Go into the sea
Dive straight down until your character touches the sand on the seabed
Come back up before you drown, and survive the disaster anywhere until the round ends
guides.title: Deep Diver

guides.name: Sisyphus
guides.howTo: In the lobby (the wooden Disaster Archive building you wait in between rounds), push the smallest red ball all the way up the stairs to the upper floor.
steps: While you're in the lobby (after a round or while spectating), find the coloured balls on the ground floor
Pick the smallest one, the red ball (not the big orange, green or yellow ones)
Walk into it to push it up the wooden staircase to the upper floor
The achievement pops up once the ball reaches the top
guides.title: Sisyphus

guides.name: Chosen One
guides.howTo: You can't do anything to trigger it. Both guides say there's a random 1-in-1,000 chance of getting it every time you survive a disaster, so you just keep surviving rounds.
steps: Survive disasters as usual; each survival is reported to give a small random chance
guides.caveat: Neither video shows it being awarded, so the 1-in-1,000 figure is the creators' word, not something we checked.

guides.name: Castaway
guides.howTo: On Venice (the canal city with a harbour), take one of the moored boats out to sea and land on the small palm-tree island on the horizon.
steps: On Venice, go to the canals or harbour and get in one of the parked motorboats
Drive out of the harbour toward the small island with palm trees on the horizon
Get onto the island; the achievement pops up when you arrive
guides.title: Castaway
